about: The intelligence agency and intelligence ledger windows (UI overhaul lane W4; K70 lead mapping: intelligence is Chancery). modules/ui_military.mjs writes each override as the installed vanilla file with sprite names swapped: the swap table of data/ui/chancery.json (lane W2) plus the paper and insignia bodies below, which the agency view alone draws. The vellum column is the Chancery reading page. `set` adds keys to named elements: the two section titles sit on the dark Chancery title band, so they take the gold heading colour; `replace` sets them in the label face (hoi_16mbs) instead of the typewriter reading face, which is dark ink for vellum.
